# ShowMyPhoto

> ShowMyPhoto is an AI-powered event photo sharing platform for photographers and event teams. Photographers can upload event photos, while guests can find their photos using selfie search, access event galleries through QR codes, and receive photos through supported sharing channels (in-gallery download, WhatsApp, email). Guests do not need to install a mobile app or create an account to access an event gallery. ShowMyPhoto is GDPR and India DPDPA compliant.

## Key Facts (Quick Answers)

- Category: AI event photo sharing / photo delivery SaaS platform
- Core capability: AI face recognition + selfie search to find guest photos in an event gallery
- Guest access: QR code or link, no app download, no login/account required
- Compliance: GDPR and India DPDPA compliant
- Delivery channels: in-gallery download, WhatsApp, email
- Social proof (as reported on the official site): 2,000+ users, 3,000+ events served, 3,000,000+ photos shared
- Pricing: free Trial plan ($0, no credit card), paid plans from $25 (Single Event) up to $500 (Enterprise); see [Pricing](https://showmyphoto.com/pricing/)
- Parent company: Sanjay Systems
- Headquarters: #5, 1st Street, S.B.O. Second Colony, Bypass Road, Madurai, Tamil Nadu 625016, India

## What ShowMyPhoto Does

ShowMyPhoto is designed for event photographers and photography businesses that need a faster way to upload, organize, share, and deliver large numbers of event photographs.

The platform focuses on:

- AI-powered facial recognition photo search
- Selfie-based photo discovery
- QR-code event photo sharing
- Event photo galleries
- Real-time / instant-upload event photo delivery
- Guest photo selection
- WhatsApp and email photo delivery
- Photographer branding
- Event photo management
- Photo download management
- Multi-photographer event workflows

## AI Facial Recognition and Selfie Search

ShowMyPhoto allows event guests to search for photographs using a selfie.

When a photographer uploads event photos, the AI automatically detects and indexes every face in the gallery. A guest then takes a selfie, and the system matches it against the indexed faces in seconds, returning only that guest's photos privately, with no facial data shared publicly.

Relevant resources:

- Selfie Search: [Selfie Search Event Photos](https://showmyphoto.com/blog/selfie-search-event-photos/)
- AI Face Recognition Photo Search: [Ai Face Recognition Photo Search](https://showmyphoto.com/blog/ai-face-recognition-photo-search/)
- Face Recognition Photo Sharing for Event Photographers: [Face Recognition Photo Sharing Event Photographers](https://showmyphoto.com/blog/face-recognition-photo-sharing-event-photographers/)
- Guest Photo Uploads and AI Sorting: [Guest Photo Uploads Ai Sorting Events](https://showmyphoto.com/blog/guest-photo-uploads-ai-sorting-events/)

## QR Code Photo Sharing

ShowMyPhoto supports QR-code based access to event photo galleries.

Guests can scan an event QR code to access the relevant photo-sharing experience without needing a dedicated mobile application.

## Privacy and Security

ShowMyPhoto is GDPR and India DPDPA compliant. Guests only ever see photos matched to their own face, never the full public gallery.

## Technology and Workflows

ShowMyPhoto's content covers AI-powered event photo workflows, online galleries, selfie search, QR access, photo delivery, and photographer-oriented event management.

The platform is intended to reduce manual photo searching and delivery work for event photographers while providing guests with a simpler way to access relevant photographs.

## Pricing

ShowMyPhoto offers a free Trial plan (no credit card required) plus paid Personal and Business plans. As of the last update, published plan names and starting prices are:

- Trial — $0 (4 events, 2,000 photos, 30-day validity)
- Single Event — $25 (1 event, 10,000 photos, unlimited AI search)
- Starter — $75 (unlimited events, 30,000 photos/year)
- Professional — $200 (unlimited events, 100,000 photos/year, unlimited AI search)
- Business — $325 (unlimited events, 250,000 photos/year, photo selection)
- Enterprise — $500 (unlimited events, 500,000 photos/year, bulk download, live share)
- Custom / White Label plans are available on request

Prices may be adjusted by region and can change. Current pricing and plan information should be obtained from the official pricing page:

[Pricing](https://showmyphoto.com/pricing/)

The pricing page is the source of truth for current plans, prices, features, limits, and promotions.
